package.name: rightkit-agent-tools
package.description: One typed tool interface for agents over rightkit-automation, rightkit-control, rightkit-browser and each app's engine commands (via rightkit-service), plus the `right-ctl <app> <command>` CLI.

package.name: rightkit-align
package.description: Product-neutral script-to-ASR word alignment: pronunciation normalisation, edit-distance alignment with lexical and timing confidence, ambiguity and mismatch rejection, and control-name coverage

package.name: rightkit-asr
package.description: Parakeet ONNX + Whisper (CoreML / whisper.cpp) speech decoding runtime for Right Suite applications

package.name: rightkit-audio
package.description: Shared audio for Right Suite apps: typed FFmpeg filter graphs, loudness gates, room tone, ducking, WAV I/O, and cpal capture with resample/downmix/recovery.

package.name: rightkit-automation
package.description: Brand-neutral desktop automation: observe and act on any app (macOS AX, Windows UIA) through a four-tier input ladder with safety, focus guard, and evidence receipts.

package.name: rightkit-browser
package.description: Shared Chrome DevTools Protocol browser runtime for Right Suite: multi-page sessions, named profiles, real CDP input, observations with stale-ref checks.

package.name: rightkit-cache
package.description: Disk cache primitive with a hard size cap, LRU eviction that survives restarts, atomic writes and group invalidation, plus stable-prefix prompt-cache keys.

package.name: rightkit-channel-memory
package.description: Channel memory for the content pipeline: the channel-memory.v1 schema with serde types, validation, version gate, proof citation rules, and scope checks for PostRight P3 and GenRight G7.

package.name: rightkit-compose
package.description: Product-neutral evaluated composition model: layered video, stills, cursor sprites, backgrounds, clipping, shadows, motion blur, overlays and keyframed tracks, with one pure per-frame evaluation shared by preview and export

package.name: rightkit-contracts
package.description: Versioned content-pipeline contracts for the Right Suite: content brief, delivery envelope, record session and event, demo plan and daemon API. JSON Schema validation, serde types, and major-version negotiation.

package.name: rightkit-control
package.description: Background native input, accessibility reads, and a WebDriver bridge for driving real desktop apps without stealing focus.

package.name: rightkit-crash
package.description: Privacy-first panic capture, redacted crash reports, native dumps and support bundles for Right Suite apps.

package.name: rightkit-daemon
package.description: Daemon host capability for the Right Suite: HTTPS listener, device enrolment and signed requests, OAuth callback and signed webhook route classes, bounded blake3-keyed resumable uploads, compare-and-swap mutations, durable state and lifecycle events.

package.name: rightkit-db
package.description: Correct-by-default SQLite and SQLCipher connection bootstrap for Right Suite apps.

package.name: rightkit-embed
package.description: Product-neutral local text embeddings and persistent cosine vector store.

package.name: rightkit-framed-sidecar
package.description: Bounded JSON-lines transport primitives for Right Suite sidecars.

package.name: rightkit-fs
package.description: Safe state directories, atomic writes, cross-process locks, owner-only files, and stable file identity for Right Suite apps.

package.name: rightkit-fsindex
package.description: Live whole-disk file index: fuzzy name search plus clone- and hard-link-aware folder size rollups on memory-mapped columns

package.name: rightkit-hotkeys
package.description: Global shortcuts and low-level input hooks for Right Suite apps: chord parsing, conflict detection, CGEventTap/WH_KEYBOARD_LL primitives, push-to-talk state.

package.name: rightkit-http
package.description: Brand-neutral blocking HTTP client for Right Suite apps: timeouts, retry/backoff with Retry-After, SSE streaming, redacted secrets, and untrusted web-text wrapping.

package.name: rightkit-jobs
package.description: Persistent job store, runner, and stdio/CLI command contract for Right Suite engines.

package.name: rightkit-license
package.description: Right Suite license enforcement primitive — offline verification of server-signed Ed25519 entitlement tokens. The Rust (security) half of @rightkit/license.

package.name: rightkit-llm
package.description: Brand-neutral BYOK LLM clients: Anthropic Messages and OpenAI-compatible chat, streaming, tool use, route failover with circuit breaker, pricing, and prompt-cache discipline.

package.name: rightkit-logs
package.description: Privacy-safe local JSONL logging and diagnostics for Right Suite desktop apps.

package.name: rightkit-mcp
package.description: Shared MCP client (stdio + streamable HTTP, trust gate, pool, OAuth hook) and server host (stdio + loopback HTTP, per-tool admission) for Right Suite apps.

package.name: rightkit-media
package.description: Verified FFmpeg artifact and lifecycle primitives for Right Suite media pipelines.

package.name: rightkit-models
package.description: Shared local-model manifest and installer for Right Suite apps: revisions and quantizations, resumable verified downloads, archive extraction, atomic activation, rollback, and hardware fit.

package.name: rightkit-oauth
package.description: Shared OAuth 2.0 sign-in for Right Suite apps: loopback PKCE, RFC 8628 device flow, provider presets, encrypted daemon persistence, and stored, refreshing credentials.

package.name: rightkit-ocr
package.description: Product-neutral OCR: Apple Vision / Windows.Media.Ocr native backends with per-line geometry, isolated worker, and verified two-stage ONNX fallback

package.name: rightkit-ort
package.description: Product-neutral ONNX Runtime dynamic-library resolution, environment, execution-provider and session setup (single suite ort pin)

package.name: rightkit-overlay
package.description: Shared overlay state, hit testing, and placement policy for Right Suite apps

package.name: rightkit-ownership
package.description: RightKit ownership scanner, verdict and admission: the single Rust implementation the RustRight broker links.

package.name: rightkit-pdf
package.description: Product-neutral PDF engine: inspect, compose (source-text replace / add text / OCR correction), font subsetting, staged atomic save, plus optional page merge/select and text extraction

package.name: rightkit-playback
package.description: Source-preserving FFmpeg compatibility playback preparation for Right Suite media apps.

package.name: rightkit-process
package.description: Ownership-safe child lifecycle, restart, and health primitives for Right Suite apps.

package.name: rightkit-qa
package.description: Rust QA harness for Right Suite apps: engine black-box scenarios, hidden native UI driving through rightkit-control, Rust-test scenario wrapper, dynamic paid-provider mocks, loudness/WAV/PNG/frame validators, run lock, orphan sweep, hashed evidence.

package.name: rightkit-review

package.name: rightkit-sandbox

package.name: rightkit-search

package.name: rightkit-secrets

package.name: rightkit-shell

package.name: rightkit-sync

package.name: rightkit-tauri
package.description: Native host services for Right Suite Tauri license and device adapters.

package.name: rightkit-transcript
package.description: Product-neutral word-timed transcript contract, cue segmentation, and SRT/VTT/JSON import and export for Right Suite applications
